sourceContracts.contract: Filter user/assistant, concatenate consecutive assistant parts under first message ID, retain unchanged presentation objects.
Raw source-row and part identity determine link provenance; visual first-row grouping cannot grant later-row authority.
Host validates exact last raw assistant row and its mutation ID selection before journal/file actions.
One turn summary aggregates mutations in raw order and is keyed to the last assistant row.

implementation: Typed view-only TranscriptGroup/TranscriptPart; first visual ID and ordered parts; original source row is not read from metadata.
No edits to AgentEngine, AgentPresentation, provider replay or durable history; no blind metadata union. Aggregate typed visible attachment refs so later-round tool-created chips remain visible.
Links, images and approvals retain original raw row/part IDs even when IDs repeat in different rounds.
Turn-file requests/actions retain last raw row ID, mapped to the combined widget only for rendering; cache and host validation unchanged.
Part equality cache and itemAt layout checks preserve settled widgets/documents/selection and avoid quadratic layout searches while streaming.
limits: Full history traversal remains linear; no virtualization.
Synthetic component and actual native host/link tests do not establish identical generated reasoning or output.
Original source-row/part identity remains authoritative; visual grouping never merges provenance metadata.
